title: Relationship Pricing: Rent Discounts on Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
A lessee of Safe Deposit Boxes may qualify for a rent discount on three grounds: an active checking account of a listed tier, age, or employment with the bank. This schedule states the percent each ground carries and how the grounds combine.

## Discount for holding an active checking account of a listed tier

The percent depends on the box size and on the checking tier held.

| Size | Active Premier Checking | Active Private Client Checking |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 50 percent | 100 percent |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 50 percent | 100 percent |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |

No other checking tier is listed in this schedule.

## Discount for age, and discount for employment

| Ground | Percent | Qualifying condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Age | 10 percent | The lessee is at least 65 whole years old on the rent due date |
| Employment | 50 percent | The lessee is an active PCB employee |

Both of these percents are the same for all six sizes.

## How the grounds combine

Only the largest applicable discount is applied. Where a lessee qualifies on more than one ground, the percents are not added together and the smaller ones fall away.

Reading the schedule as a whole: on a 3x5 Safe Deposit Box and on a 3x10 Safe Deposit Box the largest percent anywhere in this schedule is the 100 percent carried by an active Private Client Checking account; on the four larger sizes the largest percent in the schedule is 50 percent, carried both by an active Private Client Checking account and by active employment with the bank, so on those sizes a lessee who qualifies on either of those two grounds reaches the top of the schedule.
